jobs.title: Senior Network Automation & GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

**Position Title: Senior Network Automation & GIS Specialist**

  

**Base Salary:** $102,600 to $151,600 annually DOE

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible spending account, paid sick leave and paid time off, parental leave, quarterly performance bonus, training, career growth and education reimbursement programs.

  

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

  

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

  

**Our Company Values:**

  

* **Genuinely Caring:** We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.

* **Empowering You:** We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.

* **Innovation and Improvement:** We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.

* **Earning Your Trust:** We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

  

**Job Summary**

The Senior Network Automation & GIS Specialist will bring our national backbone and metro networks to life — visually, analytically, and strategically. In this role, you'll incorporate GIS and Google Earth views of Ziply Fiber's network assets — existing, planned, owned, and leased — spanning residential FTTH, data centers, and IP/transport commercial services. You'll turn that spatial and network data into insight that drives short-term and long-term network optimization strategies.

  

This is a highly cross-functional position. This role will work across engineering, network planning, construction, finance, sales, and operations to streamline deployment efficiencies, improve inventory accuracy, sharpen cost structures, and surface new revenue generation opportunities. If you love blending computer science rigor, geospatial analysis, program management, and modern AI tooling into real business outcomes, this role was built for you.

  

This role sits at the intersection of software automation, GIS, and network strategy — you'll see the whole network and help decide where it goes next.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

  

**GIS, Network Data, and Automation**

* Build, maintain, and automate GIS and Google Earth (KML/KMZ) visualizations of Ziply Fiber's national backbone and metro networks, including existing, planned, owned, and leased routes and facilities.

* Integrate network inventory, outside plant, and commercial data sources into unified geospatial views covering residential FTTH, data center connectivity, and IP/transport commercial services.

* Develop scripts, pipelines, and tools (e.g., Python, SQL, APIs) that automate data ingestion, validation, and map generation — reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.

  

**AI-Enabled Tools and Workflows**

* Leverage approved AI tools to support automation development, including code generation and review, data transformation, document and inventory analysis, and AI-assisted workflows that improve team efficiency.

* Identify opportunities to apply AI and LLM-based tooling across network planning workflows, from automated data quality checks to natural-language querying of network inventories, and prototype solutions that prove out their value.

  

**Network Strategy and Business Optimization**

* Partner with network planning and engineering to model and evaluate short-term and long-term network optimization strategies, including route consolidation, capacity planning, and lease-versus-build analysis.

* Work across teams and organizations to streamline deployment efficiencies, improve asset and fiber inventories, and identify cost reduction and revenue generation opportunities.

  

**Program Management, Reporting, and Data Governance**

* Lead cross-functional technical programs using PMO discipline: define scope and success measures, establish milestones, coordinate dependencies, manage risks, drive decisions, and communicate status and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

* Produce clear analyses, dashboards, and executive-ready visuals that inform investment, buildout, and optimization decisions.

* Set and maintain team-level technical, data governance, and documentation standards for geospatial and network data, ensuring solutions and views remain accurate, scalable, current, and trusted.

  

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization**.**

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, geographic information systems (GIS), data science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, plus five (5) to seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience in GIS, network data, software automation, data engineering, or a closely related technical field.

* Five (5) or more years of hands-on experience creating, maintaining, and automating geospatial datasets and network visualizations, including at least three (3) years using tools such as Esri ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth Pro, or KML/KMZ workflows.

* Three (3) or more years of experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs from requirements definition through implementation and ongoing support, including scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, stakeholder alignment, decision-making, and documentation; PMP or similar certification is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to translate complex or incomplete business and technical requirements into structured analyses, documented assumptions, and practical recom
